instruction: Open-choice CLI requirement: This environment provides three candidate engineering toolchains, including BIM-capable tools and a distractor tool. Choose an appropriate BIM-capable command-line or official automation workflow from these options to edit C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and export the completed IFC4 deliverable as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside the selected BIM toolchain. The current model is a small two-level pair of mirrored residential units under a shared pitched roof. The leasing team needs the room data to distinguish the A and B households without disturbing the stair cores, roof form, or the existing room layout. Register the two living rooms as the primary unit anchors for UNIT-A and UNIT-B so downstream schedules can separate the two homes.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
